title: SpaceDetail
description: Detailed information about a single Ghost space.

role.description: The caller's role in the space. Populated for user authentication; omitted for API key authentication.

owner.description: The space owner. Populated for user authentication; omitted for API key authentication.

Member.description: A member of a Ghost space.

MemberRole.description:
A member's role within a space. The `owner` role belongs to the user
who created the space; every space has exactly one owner, so `owner`
is never accepted as an input when granting a role. On the `Space`
schema, this is the caller's own role in the space, omitted for
API-key authentication (API keys are space-scoped and carry no
member identity).
